Comparisons covered terminology variants, published and published-finding corpus records, and both accessible owned ledgers. value.rationale: Complete homomorphism normal form for the entire natural class of finite regular L-algebras gives an explicit finite algorithm even for nonrectangular Young diagrams. Rectangular targets exhibit non-obvious source-shape indifference; homogeneous products realize classical pointed transformation monoids and exact graded endomorphism/idempotent/retract spectra. These are structural and reusable categorical/combinatorial invariants, not a tiny arbitrary slice or a restatement of the published object isomorphism theorem.
